agent_responses.message: Thanks for calling Bright Smile Dental, this is Riley. How can I help you today?
Hey, yeah, uh, I don't have insurance and I was wondering how much a cleaning would cost me out of pocket.

An out-of-pocket cleaning and checkup is one hundred and forty-five dollars, which includes the cleaning, an exam with Dr. Patel, and X-rays if you are due for them. If you are a new patient to our clinic, the first visit is a ninety-minute comprehensive exam, full X-rays, and cleaning for two hundred and ten dollars. Have you been to see us before?
No, I haven't been there before. Is there any kind of plan or discount to save money if I come in regularly?

Yes, we actually have the Bright Smile membership plan for twenty-nine dollars a month. It covers two cleanings, exams, and X-rays each year, plus you get twenty percent off any other treatments. Would you like to look at booking that first new patient exam and cleaning?
Hmm, ok. And where are you guys located?
We are located at twenty-four hundred South Lamar Boulevard, in Suite two ten, right here in Austin. There is free parking in the lot behind our building.
Alright, got it. I'm not ready to book right now but thanks for the info.
Of course! Feel free to give us a call back whenever you're ready to schedule. Have a wonderful day!
